newsitem.title: USA: ISS backs Baldwin Piano in proxy fight.
newsitem.headline: ISS backs Baldwin Piano in proxy fight.

text.p: Baldwin Piano & Organ Co said Monday that Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) has endorsed the company's slate of directors over those proposed by Kenneth Pavia, general partner of Bolero Investments Group LP, which owns 8.1 percent of the company.
Bolero has nominated five directors to Baldwin's board. Shareholders will vote for directors at the annual meeting, June 12.
ISS agreed with Baldwin that disrupting its turnaround plan by replacing the board would not be in shareholders' best interests, the company said.
Karen Hendricks, chairman and CEO of Baldwin said, "We are pleased that ISS, a neutral party that is well-versed in these matters, has endorsed Baldwin's slate."
Institutional Shareholder Services, based in Bethesda, Md., is an independent advisor on proxy contests and corporate governance issues for large shareholders.
